Just a lil update on one of the best looking sarrs I've purchased from Mike...the Leo Song hybrid (oreo x purpurea)

Got it back in May and now we're almost mid-way through August and this thing has EXPLODED with growth. Posted an imgur album of some pics I took today along with a comparison of when I potted it up in May vs today.

imgur.com/a/LYPrvHz



Okay so now its getting to be dormancy season soon so I figured I'd update my post on what Leo Song looks like today ... needless to say this is one of the best looking sarrs I own and if anyone wants a great colored, clumpy, well growing sarr...I cannot recommend it enough!!

I trimmed the two pitchers it arrived with, today before taking this pic so you can see everything it grew in my care. Those pitchers were pretty dead by now anyway.


imgur.com/a/E227tYX

Hi everyone, sorry that I have not been active on this forum, I guess I'm just too used to being on my phone anymore! I'll try to post on here more, promise  . Some of you may know me on Instagram as JerseyDevilCarnivorousPlants (I realize I have no post history here, I'm more than happy to confirm my identity via IG just message me there.) Let me say that I have been buying plants from Mike for years now and have never had a bad transaction. The plants I've purchased have always been healthy, vigorous specimens, and it's always exciting to see what new additions he's put out for sale. Mike is a man of integrity and sets a fantastic example for all of us who buy, sell, and trade plants in this hobby. I can personally attest to this-for example he accidentally forgot one of the plants in in an order and followed up by promptly sending another package! Believe me I do a lot of shopping online, mistakes happen to everyone, so it's nice to feel confident in your seller. I cannot recommend enough purchasing plants from Mike, and always look forward to the next. 

Happy growing all!
Josh
